input_schema.primary_sequence: OHLCV (Open, High, Low, Close, Volume, Timestamp_ms)
input_schema.context_vector: Microstructure 8-Vector (OFI, VPIN, MidReturn, SpreadBps, DepthImb, TradeSign, VolClock, RestingWall)

output_schema.trajectory_paths: M Monte Carlo paths of H forward steps (Predicted OHLCV)

limitations: Native inference requires PyTorch weights on local GPU/CPU; falls back automatically to SURROGATE provider if weights unavailable.
Forecasts represent conditional probability density over future return horizons, NOT trade execution signals.
Must be calibrated against realized forward outcomes using Platt scaling and verified by Brier Score before inclusion in research context.
